component.name: QuickCompress
component.summary: Compress and convert images, audio, and videos for chat and web

description.p: QuickCompress is a fast, lightweight, and modern utility built with GTK4 and Libadwaita for Linux. It helps you instantly shrink videos for Discord and WhatsApp, optimize photos to WebP, resize images, and strip sensitive GPS camera metadata.

ul.li: Drag-and-drop or paste directly from clipboard (Ctrl+V)
Automatic video bitrate calculation to fit 10 MB or 25 MB limits
High efficiency WebP and JPEG compression
Batch processing for multiple files at once
Privacy protection with one-click EXIF stripping

description.p: Initial release with batch support, clipboard pasting, video compression, and WebP optimizer.
